system.description:
Half-Orc

Half-orcs are the offspring of humans and orcs, inheriting the strength and endurance of their orc heritage alongside the intelligence and adaptability of their human side. They average 5½ to 6 feet in height and have a somewhat brutish appearance. Half-orcs are often viewed with suspicion, particularly in civilized areas.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Strength: +1
  • Constitution: +1
  • Charisma: −2

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Pass for Human: A half-orc with Charisma 13 or higher and an average or better appearance can often pass for human in dim lighting or from a distance.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Cleric, Thief, Assassin; Fighter/Cleric, Fighter/Thief, Cleric/Thief, Cleric/Assassin, Fighter/Cleric/Thief, Fighter/Assassin multiclass.

specialAbilities.description: A half-orc with CHA 13+ may pass for human in dim lighting or at distance.
